periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertical orientation of the visible eye patches relative to the craniofacial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a high vertical-to-horizontal ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible downward tapering where the patch width decreases significantly toward the ventral margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The visible portions of the posterior edge suggest a broad U-shaped curve.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 30% of the visible dorsal-to-ventral torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear distance is approximately equal to the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly curved, rounded apex at the top boundary of both ear regions.
